title: Merrygold F1 Tomato - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Blight Resistant Orange Tomato
description:
Merrygold produces bright orange cherry tomatoes with a rich, aromatic flavour, making them ideal for summer salads and fresh eating. This variety is blight resistant and known for being high yielding.


 Key features:


  Variety: Merrygold
 

  Type: Indeterminate (cordon – requires support)
 

  Fruit: Small, bright orange cherry tomatoes
 

  Taste: Rich and aromatic
 

  Good disease resistance (including blight)
 

  High yielding plants
 

 Growing information:


  Sow: Spring, approx. 5mm deep
 

  Germination: 7–14 days at 17–21°C
 

  Potting: Transplant seedlings into 3-inch pots when large enough to handle
 

  Planting out: When approx. 8 inches tall
 

  Spacing: 18 inches apart
 

  Position: Warm, sunny location
 

  Soil: Moist, fertile, well-drained
 

  Watering: Keep well watered
 

 Suitable for growing in a greenhouse or outdoors (after gradual acclimatisation).
